thread:
ana: Heads-up: platform noticed small but visible drift in per-route quota dashboards. Traced to TS/Go SDKs switching to `x-rd-route` while some edge proxies rewrite header names to underscores. Console aggregates only the canonical `x-route` currently. We need a short migration plan.

kevin: Yikes. Which proxies? nginx? internal apigee?

ana: Mostly nginx + some customer edge gateways. They change `x-rd-route` -> `x_rd_route`.

rui: SDK fix: emit both canonical and backward header names for 2 releases behind flag. Also add a small backfill telemetry event when both present to detect mismatch. Example (Go):

```
hdr.Set("x-rd-route", v)
hdr.Add("x_route", v) // shim
```

olga: Console-side: we can normalize header keys server-side (replace _, -, . -> -) and treat them case-insensitively. Also add a mapping table so incoming `x_rd_route` maps to the route dimension.

kevin: Important: ledger keys used for billing must not change. Mapping should only affect UI labels and alerts. Confirmable?

rui: Yes. SDKs will keep the same route fingerprint algorithm. No ledger churn.

olga: UX: banner in route settings + a small modal explaining why mapping exists and expected cutover date. Also add a dashboard split: native vs normalized so product can monitor adoption.

ana: Telemetry: emit `route_header_normalized=true/false` sampled per request, with token count. Our sampling pipeline can slice by customer and route.

kevin: Ops: can we run a canary for mapping in staging and then prod? deploy tooling should flag any large unknown buckets.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary for header normalization in us-west-2: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 40m. Watch: console-quota, route-normalization-errors.

rui: Action items:
- rui: dual-header PRs for TS/Go (ETA 24h) + note for Py maintainers
- olga: console normalize + banner + mapped/native tile (ETA 48h)
- kevin: confirm ledger immutability + add sampling slice (ETA 48h)
- ana: customer comms draft (ETA Fri)

ana: Quick edge case: some customers have proxies that drop unknown headers. We should add doc snippets for nginx/envoy to preserve `x-rd-route`.

olga: Will include docs and example curl.

kevin: Thanks. If anyone sees >5% unknown bucket after canary ping #incidents.

rui: PR will include feature flag default-on and a changelog note. Tagging here when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% in us-west-2, no errors reported.

ana: Great, keeping this short. Cheers.
